rows.q: 总销售额是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS "总销售额" FROM orders
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 一共有多少个订单？
rows.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS "订单数" FROM orders
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 哪个月份的销售额最高？
rows.sql: SELECT month AS "月份", SUM(revenue) AS "销售额" FROM orders GROUP BY "月份" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 每个月的销售额分别是多少？
rows.why: 期望 13 行，实际 13 行
rows.sql:
SELECT month AS "月份", SUM(revenue) AS "销售额" FROM orders GROUP BY "月份" ORDER BY "月份"
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 哪个国家的销售额最高？
rows.why: 期望「United Kingdom」=9,025,222.08，实际首行 ['United Kingdom', 9025222.08]
rows.sql: SELECT country AS "国家", CAST(total_revenue AS REAL) AS "销售额" FROM countries ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 英国贡献的销售额占比是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT 
  (SELECT CAST(total_revenue AS REAL) FROM countries WHERE country = 'United Kingdom') * 100.0 / 
  (SELECT SUM(CAST(total_revenue AS REAL)) FROM countries) AS "英国销售额占比"
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 销售额最高的 5 个产品是哪些？
rows.why: 期望「DOTCOM POSTAGE」=206,248.77，实际首行 ['DOTCOM POSTAGE', 206248.77]
rows.sql: SELECT description AS "产品", CAST(total_revenue AS REAL) AS "销售额" FROM products ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 5
rows.summary: DOTCOM POSTAGE的销售额最高（206,249），PARTY BUNTING最低（99,504）；结构高度集中，前 3 项贡献超过 70%。

rows.q: 销量最大的产品是哪个？
rows.why: 期望「PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE」=80,995.00，实际首行 ['PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE', 80995.0]
rows.sql: SELECT description AS "产品", CAST(total_qty AS REAL) AS "销量" FROM products ORDER BY "销量" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 每周几的销售额最高？
rows.sql: SELECT weekday AS "星期", SUM(revenue) AS "销售额" FROM orders GROUP BY "星期" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 平均每单金额是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS "平均每单金额" FROM orders
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 下单次数最多的客户花了多少钱？
rows.sql: SELECT total_revenue AS "销售额" FROM customers WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM customers GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY CAST(order_count AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

rows.q: 2011 年 11 月的销售额是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS "销售额" FROM orders WHERE month = '2011-11'
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 销量前 5 的产品是哪些？
rows.why: 期望「PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE」=80,995.00，实际首行 ['PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE', 80995.0]
rows.sql: SELECT description AS "产品", CAST(total_qty AS REAL) AS "销量" FROM products ORDER BY "销量" DESC LIMIT 5
rows.summary: PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE的销量最高（80,995），JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT最低（48,474）。

rows.q: 销售额第二高的国家是哪个？
rows.sql: SELECT country AS "国家" FROM countries ORDER BY CAST(total_revenue AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
rows.summary: 共返回 1 行数据，但没有可汇总的数值列。

rows.q: 一共有多少个客户下过单？
rows.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS "客户数" FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 英国以外销售额最高的国家是哪个？
rows.sql: SELECT country AS "国家", CAST(total_revenue AS REAL) AS "销售额" FROM countries WHERE country != 'United Kingdom' ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 销售额最少的星期几？
rows.sql: SELECT weekday AS "星期几", SUM(revenue) AS "销售额" FROM orders GROUP BY "星期几" ORDER BY "销售额" ASC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 订单数最多的月份是哪个？
rows.sql: SELECT month AS "月份", COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS "订单数" FROM orders GROUP BY "月份" ORDER BY "订单数" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 平均每笔商品行金额是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT AVG(revenue) AS "平均每笔商品行金额" FROM orders
LIMIT 500

rows.q: 2011 年 3 月的订单数是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS "订单数" FROM orders WHERE month = '2011-03'
LIMIT 500
